verdicts.reason: A rearranges the layout so the quote is large and readable, but it sits right up against the top edge. The logo is wedged between the attribution and the product, the product can shrinks to a tiny icon with its SOLSTICE label lost, and the right half of the bottom is dead space. B is just the original shrunk to the new size: the quote is small, the attribution, can label and logo are too small to read, and the logo is jammed against the bottom-left edge with a large empty area above the quote.
